collection.description: An Isolan family and a village family both want to host a feast: combine the traditions, or hold two feasts.

question.name: The Feast of Two Traditions
question.text: A converted Isolan family and a village family each offer to host a feast, but neither agrees on how it should be prepared.

variants.text: An Isolan family who came to live with our tribe and a village family each offer to host a feast, but neither agrees on how it should be prepared.

a1.text: The meal becomes a new annual celebration.

b1.text: Guests attend both and exchange stories late into the night.

b2.text: A scheduling mishap leaves both feasts short of cooks.

b3.text: The families decide that next year they will cook together.

a2__fx.text: The cooks produce an astonishingly strange dish that tastes unexpectedly wonderful.

a2__text.text: The cooks produce an astonishingly strange dish that tastes unexpectedly wonderful.

a3__fx.text: The two head cooks quarrel, then discover their children have already eaten everything.
